metadata.description: Automated terminal workflow: Start server, authenticate, and test endpoints.

laravel_cli_workflow.execution_steps: Step 1: Start Laravel built-in development server in the background (php artisan serve). Step 2: Send a POST request to using curl with the provided credentials. Step 3: Capture the returned authentication token/cookie from the login response dynamically into working memory. Step 4: Use that captured token to test a protected endpoint (e.g., GET /api/v1/orders) to verify if the response structure matches expected parameters. Step 5: If any parameters are mismatched or broken, output the code fixes for the Controller/Resource.
